body:
Finally, a nice afternoon of shrooms with my boyfriend and best friend. The hunt for shrooms itself was a process so this day was highly anticipated.
Everyone munched them down with a combo of doritos, though I do actuallly enjoy the taste of mushrooms.
Unfortunately 3 hours later to no avail I felt nothing. This I feel is directly linked to taking Abilify for which I get monthly injections.
Shrooms and acid have no effect when I'm on abilify. Just reminds you how potent this little elixir is when you're prescribed it.
